creature_families: blood race: 633 files (largest bucket; not checked file by file)
ink race: 16 files (book, squid and library theme)
boss-flagged (isboss=1): 294 files; 79 files carry isboss=0 explicitly
boss pattern: boss flag plus timed rolls (self-heal, self-haste, invisibility, outfit transform, radius speed-steal, capped summon pool, re-target); 5 to 12 attack lines per boss
creature voice barks in 651 files; 164 summon lines across the folder

top_creatures.label: Hellfire Summoner
top_creatures.why: Fire boss that keeps a capped pool of summons topped up on a one-second roll and hastes itself for a few seconds; a readable call-then-run tell.
top_creatures.keep: Capped summon pool (cap four) and the self-haste as the telegraph.
top_creatures.change: Silhouette, summon names, element, and a sound before the haste so the tell is heard as well as seen.

top_creatures.label: Veil Colossus
top_creatures.why: Giant energy-race boss (800,000 health) that drops out of sight in two short windows; invisibility is the timing puzzle.
top_creatures.keep: Short invisible windows as the tell.
top_creatures.change: Its own shimmer and sound per window; cut twelve attack lines to about five for a 375 px screen.

top_creatures.label: Elder Wyrm
top_creatures.why: Blood-race dragon whose radius speed-steal turns the ground around it into a slow zone for about ten seconds.
top_creatures.keep: Radius slow as a shaped, readable threat.
top_creatures.change: Element, silhouette, and a shorter slow of a few seconds.

top_creatures.label: Shifting Beast
top_creatures.why: Two-phase boss: a mid-fight outfit transform into a beast form plus a self-haste.
top_creatures.keep: Mid-fight form change as a second phase.
top_creatures.change: Our own beast form and a stinger on the change.

top_creatures.label: Twin Minion Lord
top_creatures.why: Largest experience value among the 294 boss-flagged files; two minion species, each capped at three, summoned on separate rolls.
top_creatures.keep: Two separate summon pools with separate caps.
top_creatures.change: Our minion species; the engine caps attackers at three (MAX_ATTACKERS = 3), so pools need an engine-side cap.
top_creatures.ref: data/monster/monsters/gaz'haragoth.xml lines 54 and 55 (line 54 checked by grep; apostrophe in filename, not in receipts.tsv)

top_creatures.label: Gilded Sentinel
top_creatures.why: Low-health gold-tinted construct that barks idle lines on a timer, so idle creatures are never silent.
top_creatures.keep: Idle barks on an interval with a low chance.
top_creatures.change: Silhouette, palette, and our own barks.

top_creatures.label: Animated Tome Pack
top_creatures.why: Cheap pack of animated books with one healer that has a radius-four heal aura; a family themed on library objects.
top_creatures.ref: data/monster/monsters/flying_book.xml line 2; data/monster/monsters/librarian.xml (not opened line by line)

top_creatures.label: Emperor's Revenant
top_creatures.why: Undead boss with a twenty-second area slow and a summon cap of two, in a three-file family.
top_creatures.keep: The long slow as a rhythm of quiet and loud periods.
top_creatures.change: Shorten the slow to a few seconds for mobile play; change the summon.

looks.label: Shared aura for two different tells
looks.technique: blueshimmer is the top area effect (511 lines); the same blue aura marks self-heal (lines 40, 43) and invisibility (line 46) in one boss. Give each defence its own aura and sound.

looks.label: Outfit transform mid-fight
looks.technique: Timed model swap through the outfit defence and attack (59 attack lines use outfit).

looks.label: Status wobble
looks.technique: Drunk attack (75 lines), for example radius five for nine seconds on the colossus; client effect not read.

looks.label: Speed tell with signed change
looks.technique: Speed attack and defence lines (210 lines); a slow or haste with a visible aura.

looks.label: Idle barks on a timer
looks.technique: Voices block with interval and chance; present in 651 files.

looks.label: Element on the weapon, not a recolour
looks.technique: Element attribute (4 to 9) on one base shape; four element copies with identical stats. Client look per item id not read.
looks.ref: data/items/items.xml lines 13846 (fiery crystal mace) and 13946 (icy dragon slayer)

looks.label: Glow in names only
looks.technique: Item names carry glowing (48) and crystal (250); no glow attribute in items.xml; the glow is a client job (not read).

originals.change: Own shimmer and sound; about five attacks, not twelve.
